bib.title: APIGen: Automated PIpeline for Generating Verifiable and Diverse Function-Calling Datasets

read.skipped: Figures 1-5 are images and were not viewed; only captions read. Fig 5 values are not in the text.

question: How can verifiable, diverse function-calling training data be synthesised at scale, and does training on it make small models competitive on function calling?
hypothesis: Execution-based and semantic verification of generated function calls yields higher-quality data than unfiltered generation, so small models trained on it can match much larger ones.
contributions: APIGen, a function-calling data generation pipeline featuring verifiability, scalability, and diversity
Two function-calling models, 1.3B and 6.7B, trained on APIGen data; the 6.7B ranks 6th on BFCL and the 1.3B outperforms GPT-3.5-Turbo
A released synthetic dataset of 60,000 verified entries

method.summary: An LLM generates query-answer pairs (answers are JSON function calls) from sampled APIs, seed examples and prompt templates. Each pair passes a format checker, an execution checker (real execution) and an LLM semantic checker. DeepSeek-Coder 1.3B and 7B are fine-tuned on the verified data plus 8,000 relevance-detection points and evaluated on BFCL.
method.task: synthetic data generation for function calling; supervised fine-tuning of function-calling models

datasets.name: APIGen API library (from ToolBench / RapidAPI)
datasets.size: 3,673 executable APIs in 21 categories (3,539 REST APIs after cleaning from 16,464 in 49 categories, plus 134 Python functions)
datasets.source: ToolBench; accessibility tested via StableToolBench server
datasets.preprocessing: Removed APIs with badly parsed docs or no required/optional parameters; dropped APIs that errored or timed out; regenerated noisy docstrings; merged overlapping categories into 21

datasets.name: APIGen generated dataset (xlam-function-calling-60k)
datasets.size: approximately 60,000 verified entries (from Mixtral-8x22B-Inst and DeepSeek-V2-Chat); query styles simple, multiple, parallel, parallel multiple
datasets.source: Generated by APIGen; CC BY 4.0; Hugging Face Salesforce/xlam-function-calling-60k
datasets.preprocessing: Passed format, execution and semantic checks

datasets.name: Relevance-detection data
datasets.source: Derived from the collected dataset by randomly discarding tools called in the answer or dropping required parameters, then relabelling the answer as an empty tool call or a short explanation

datasets.name: Berkeley Function-Calling Benchmark (BFCL)
datasets.source: Yan et al. 2024; Java, JavaScript, Python

datasets.name: Human evaluation sample
datasets.size: 600 samples from the released dataset, 3 evaluators

other.note: identity of the checker LLM not stated

training.objective: supervised fine-tuning to predict tool calls in JSON given query and tools (xLAM pipeline from AgentOhana)
training.batch_size: 6 per device, 2 gradient accumulation steps (effective 96 on 8 GPUs, inferred)

other.mixture: verified APIGen data plus 8,000 relevance-detection points; exact training-set size not stated

inference.samples: Generation target 40,000 data points per generator model; BFCL evaluation runs not stated
inference.prompting: Generator prompt with {examples}, {number}, {func_name}, {func_desc}, {format_inst}; several queries per call ('batching'); 'thought' field as CoT

parameters.semantic_checker_criteria: 5 criteria (alignment and args, right function chosen, call count, errors in results, relevance of results)
parameters.example_and_API_count: randomly chosen from a predefined range (range not given)

metrics.name: BFCL overall accuracy
metrics.definition: weighted average over AST (simple, multiple, parallel, parallel multiple), executable (same four) and relevance detection categories

metrics.name: Pass rate (data)
metrics.definition: verified / 40,000 generated, after format, execution and semantic checks

metrics.name: Human-evaluated quality
metrics.definition: share of 600 sampled entries without issues, judged by 3 evaluators

baselines: ablation with filtered-out data added back
eval.protocol: BFCL leaderboard snapshot as of 06/15/2024; no seeds, runs or significance tests reported.

availability.weights: planned release on Hugging Face after legal approval

prompts.text: You are a data labeler. The responsibility for you is to generate a set of diverse queries and corresponding answers for the given functions in JSON format. ... Based on these examples and the above instructions, generate {number} diverse query and answer pairs for the functions `{func_name}`. The detailed functions description is as follows: {func_desc} {format_inst} Now please generate {number} diverse query and answer pairs following the above format.
prompts.where: Appendix B.1 (abridged here; full text on pp.16-17)

prompts.text: As a data quality evaluator, you must assess the alignment between a user query, corresponding function calls, and their execution results. ... Do not pass if: 1. The function call does not align with the query's objective, or the input arguments appear incorrect. 2. ... 5. The execution results contain errors or reflect that the function calls were not executed successfully. ... Provide your reasoning in the thought section and decide if the data passes (answer yes or no).

[BEGIN OF TASK INSTRUCTION] You are an expert in composing functions. You are given a question and a set of possible functions. Based on the question, you will need to make one or more function/tool calls to achieve the purpose. If none of the function can be used, point it out and refuse to answer. If the given question lacks the parameters required by the function, also point it out. [END OF TASK INSTRUCTION] [BEGIN OF AVAILABLE TOOLS] {func_desc} [END OF AVAILABLE TOOLS] ... [BEGIN OF QUERY] User Query: {query} [END OF QUERY]

results.table: Table 2, row xLAM-1B (FC), column Overall Accuracy

results.table: Table 1, row DeepSeek-V2-Chat (236B), column Pass Rate

results.claim: Adding data rejected by the execution and semantic checkers back into training lowers BFCL performance, more for the smaller model.

limits: Only REST APIs and Python functions are covered.
Only single-turn function calling is implemented; multi-turn left to future work.
Ablation shown only as a figure; no seeds, runs or confidence intervals; one benchmark (BFCL) at one leaderboard date.
Semantic checker model and sampling ranges not specified; code not released; model weights pending legal approval.
Human evaluation has 3 raters with no agreement stat; leaderboard ranks from 2024 have dated.
